description: This file contains the implementation of the PSR-7 Request class, which provides an object-oriented representation of an HTTP request, including methods to access and manipulate request components like method, URI, headers, and request target.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Implementation of the PSR-7 HTTP request interface, providing methods to create and modify HTTP request objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the Request object with method, URI, headers, body, and protocol version.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns the request target string, constructing it from the URI if not explicitly set.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified request target.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP method.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI object associated with the request.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified URI, optionally preserving the Host header.
